card: Tap My card in the header, or Enlarge on Home. Show the QR code or your member number at the venue.
wallet: Open My card. Where the venue offers it, use Add to Apple Wallet or Add to Google Wallet.
balance: Your balance is on Home. See all beside Recent activity opens every points change.
spend: Choose an available reward in Rewards, then Redeem. Confirm to receive a code for the venue.
benefits: Rewards brings your level benefits together. Some apply automatically; others have a Request this button.
offers: Extras for members appear alongside the other rewards. Claim an available offer to use it.
book: Use Book on Home or Bookings, choose what and when, then confirm.
details: In Profile, choose Edit beside Personal details. Ask the venue to change your email.
messages: In Profile, open Notifications. A kind you switch off is not sent at all. Expand How we reach you for delivery channels.
delete: In Profile, expand Account & help, then choose Delete account.
sign_up: Open Events from Home, Rewards or Account & help in Profile. Choose Sign up. You can cancel there too.
door: Open My card in the header. The team scans its QR code.
